lane: Website step T1 of docs/proposals/SHARE_TAROT_LANDING_FLOW_2026-11-28.vi.md. Owner approved 28/11/2026: "Bắt đầu T1" with decisions: one web draw per day, include-meaning on by default, orientation in the link, basic meaning shown with a CTA to the app, order T1 → T2 → T3.
goal: On /vi/share/card and /vi/share/reading: show the friend card(s) in the right orientation, with the library meaning only when the link carries the meaning flag; one visitor draw per Vietnam day kept in the browser, showing the card, orientation, keywords, the library meaning for that orientation and the card question, then a call to action to the app (waitlist until Play is public); no more unlimited redraws. Prepare the Play link to carry the drawn card as an install referrer for T3.
successCriteria: Links with o= (one 0/1 per card) show reversed cards rotated and labelled; links without o= behave as before (upright).
m=1 shows the orientation meaning under each friend card; without it no meaning is shown.
The visitor draws at most once per Vietnam day per browser; reloading the same day shows the same card and no draw button; a new day allows a new draw; broken or old stored values are ignored.
The drawn card shows the meaning for its orientation and the card question, then a CTA whose copy names what the app adds (ask about your own situation, keep notes).
When playStoreUrl is set, the CTA link carries a referrer with only the drawn card id, orientation, day and surface; with no draw it carries only the surface.
Nothing from the address becomes markup; analytics keep enumerated values only.
Shortlink options researched and written up for the Owner (no code).
untouchedSurfaces: App code (T2) and Play referrer reading in the app (T3).
No SQL, Edge Function, secret, Cloudflare or Vercel setting change. Web deploy after merge needs the Owner approval.
Card library text is unchanged in this PR; the meaning review result is reported to the Owner.

impact.entryPoint: Share link or QR of a today card or a reading opens /vi/share/card or /vi/share/reading.
impact.dataWrite: Browser localStorage only: the visitor draw of the day (card id, orientation, day). Nothing sent to a server.
impact.backendContract: Unchanged: no API call is added; the waitlist form is unchanged.
impact.adminVisibility: Unchanged: no Admin field or metric touched.
impact.privacySafety: Only public library text; the link carries card ids, 0/1 orientation and a 0/1 meaning flag; no name, question, notes or AI text.
impact.rollback: Revert the PR and redeploy the previous web build; old links keep working because new parameters are optional.
impact.observability: Existing share_link_opened, share_landing_try and waitlist_cta_click events; no new event.
